204.title: Refresh running job progress without reloading the page
204.body:
**Roadmap order: A1 (01 of 11)** · **Priority: P1** · **Phase: A — Free v0.2**

Planning baseline: live `main` `c48e307efe7750d0fb36015c39d50a34675f9579`, fetched and checked 2026-10-07. This issue is scoped future work; v0.1 UX and WordPress.org submission stay closed. Founder retains final GO / NO-GO.

## Problem

Background jobs persist progress, but merchants must refresh or revisit Progress/Results to see current Apply and Undo outcomes. An unchanged page can look stalled after the server has advanced.

## Why now

First Free v0.2 improvement: complete the background-processing promise before convenience options or commercial work. This extends the accepted v0.1 workflow; it does not reopen visual polish.

## Scope

- Add bounded, authenticated read-only progress updates to the existing Woo-native, PHP-rendered job view.
- Refresh persisted pending/completed/conflict/failure/uncertain and Undo counts plus visible outcome rows and action availability.
- Use persisted server state as authority; show connection/session errors and last successful refresh instead of fabricated completion.
- Stop/back off polling appropriately for terminal jobs, hidden pages and failures; retain manual refresh and the no-JS workflow.

## Non-goals

No SPA/React rewrite, new scheduler, worker execution through polling, optimistic mutation status, global catalog refresh or paid prerequisite. Do not change frozen plans, approval, Resume or Undo authority.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] A real running Apply and Undo job advances on screen without page reload; counts agree with saved server observations.
- [ ] Conflicts, failures, uncertain outcomes and stalled work remain distinct from success.
- [ ] Polling changes no product/job/Undo state, installs no schema and never invokes workers; unauthorized/cross-actor reads are refused without data disclosure.
- [ ] Out-of-order responses cannot regress displayed observations; failed/expired sessions show an actionable stale-display message.
- [ ] Updates preserve keyboard focus and announce concise status changes without repeatedly reading the whole table.
- [ ] Existing targeted Admin/authentication journeys and no-JS/manual refresh remain usable; no new broad validation matrix.

## Dependencies

No new code prerequisite. First execution item in Phase A. Reuse the completed jobs/Admin foundations (#109, #168, #170).

## Evidence

- [Current server-rendered Progress/Results](https://github.com/MrDarkRoot/WriteLeash/blob/c48e307efe7750d0fb36015c39d50a34675f9579/wordpress/writeleash/includes/free/class-free-admin.php#L1491-L1591).
- [Current selection-only JavaScript](https://github.com/MrDarkRoot/WriteLeash/blob/c48e307efe7750d0fb36015c39d50a34675f9579/wordpress/writeleash/includes/free/free-selection.js).
- #168 and #170 are completed baseline work, not tickets to reopen.

206.title: Include subcategories and show the expanded product selection
206.body:
**Roadmap order: A3 (03 of 11)** · **Priority: P1** · **Phase: A — Free v0.2**

Planning baseline: live `main` `c48e307efe7750d0fb36015c39d50a34675f9579`, fetched and checked 2026-10-07. This issue is scoped future work; v0.1 UX and WordPress.org submission stay closed. Founder retains final GO / NO-GO.

## Problem

Category selection deliberately includes direct members only. Merchants selecting a parent category can miss its descendants, and a variable parent expands into a different number of actual price targets.

## Why now

Third Free priority: make category scope explicit before expanding pricing operations. Descendant selection was explicitly outside completed #167.

## Scope

- Add an explicit Include subcategories option while preserving direct-members-only as the existing/default behavior.
- Show a bounded server-derived count of deduplicated price targets after category/variation expansion before Preview, including a clear over-limit indication.
- Treat that count as discovery information; Preview independently resolves and freezes the actual reviewed IDs.

## Non-goals

No individual exclusions, include/exclude lists, filter frameworks, generic query builder, arbitrary taxonomy/meta filters, changed job ceiling, auto-selection of search results or paid filtering gate. A strong exclusion workflow may receive separate product consideration later only if supported by real merchant evidence.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Parent-only and descendants-enabled selections resolve the expected products across nested categories without duplicates.
- [ ] Variable-parent expansion/counting matches the planner's actual target semantics, including overlapping memberships.
- [ ] Empty, unreadable and over-limit selections are explained before approval; existing 1,000/1,001 boundaries remain intact.
- [ ] A category change between count display and Preview cannot authorize unseen products; the final Preview is authoritative and execution never reselects the live category.
- [ ] The toggle/scope is visible in the review and retained plan context; old plans still hydrate with direct-members semantics.

## Dependencies

**Roadmap sequencing:** #204 → #205 → #206 is the preferred merchant-value lane.

**Functional dependency:** no requirement for #204 or #205 to complete before selection work starts. Reuse the completed #167 picker and #179 variation expansion; Preview must still resolve and freeze the actual IDs.

## Parallel execution

Selection work can usually proceed alongside #209, early #210 inventory/tooling and #213 research. Coordinate shared Admin form changes with #204/#205; if source changes collide heavily, sequence/rebase rather than rely on another unmerged branch.

## Evidence

- [Direct membership query](https://github.com/MrDarkRoot/WriteLeash/blob/c48e307efe7750d0fb36015c39d50a34675f9579/wordpress/writeleash/includes/free/class-product-selector.php#L64-L69).
- [Current category disclosure](https://github.com/MrDarkRoot/WriteLeash/blob/c48e307efe7750d0fb36015c39d50a34675f9579/wordpress/writeleash/includes/free/class-free-admin.php#L1219-L1254).
- #167 explicitly excluded category descendants; #179 completed variation selection.

209.title: Remove WooCommerce Internal cache dependencies
209.body:
**Roadmap order: B1 (06 of 11)** · **Priority: P1** · **Phase: B — Woo Marketplace technical readiness**

Planning baseline: live `main` `c48e307efe7750d0fb36015c39d50a34675f9579`, fetched and checked 2026-10-07. This issue is scoped future work; v0.1 UX and WordPress.org submission stay closed. Founder retains final GO / NO-GO.

## Problem

Current main references `Automattic\WooCommerce\Internal\Caches\ProductCache` in both execution/cache invalidation and Admin current-price observation. Woo's official extension guidance says Internal code must not be used; guards do not turn it into a supported API.

## Why now

First issue in the Marketplace engineering lane: remove a verified API dependency while protecting freshness and conservative recovery. Its roadmap phase follows Free improvement planning, but this work can start independently.

## Scope

- Inventory all runtime references, including string-based lookups; the verified sites are Price_Cache_Verifier::invalidate and Free_Admin::product_observation.
- Replace them with supported public mechanisms and document how fresh product/variation/parent values are obtained.
- Preserve public Woo CRUD writes, targeted cache repair, stored/lookup coherence checks, transaction fences and post-commit observations.
- If a supported replacement cannot provide the required guarantee, document the concrete limitation and request Woo guidance; do not manufacture an all-clear.

## Non-goals

No removal of cache invalidation, global cache flushing, private class wrapper presented as public, weakened verification, direct Woo price SQL writes, custom-table removal or engine rewrite.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Shipped runtime has no dependency on Woo Internal classes/code for these paths; string-based references are included in the check.
- [ ] After a concurrent supported edit, Preview/Apply/current observation/Undo read correct values and preserve relevant newer edits.
- [ ] Focused default and persistent-cache tests cover simple products, variations/parent ranges, rollback, recovery and current-price display using the affected existing harnesses.
- [ ] Supported versions both before and after the former ProductCache availability boundary behave correctly; version-specific tests are limited to the changed cache assumptions.
- [ ] Missing support/freshness fails visibly and conservatively; uncertain outcomes are not relabeled success.

## Dependencies

**Roadmap sequencing:** listed after Free improvements for product focus.

**Functional dependency:** none on completion of Phase A, including #204–#208. In particular, #206, #207 and #208 are not prerequisites. Completed #108/#110/#180 provide reusable correctness/compatibility evidence, not new broad gates.

## Parallel execution

This issue may execute in parallel with remaining Free work, early #210 i18n inventory/tooling and #213 research. Coordinate merge order with #204/#205 if they touch the same Admin/cache observation code; use small PRs and rebase instead of false prerequisites. #209 and #210 may also overlap in `class-free-admin.php`. Future code PRs need current main, narrow scope, appropriate tests and review; no self-merge without separate authorization. Sequence heavily colliding edits rather than rely on unmerged behavior.

## Evidence

- [Execution cache reference](https://github.com/MrDarkRoot/WriteLeash/blob/c48e307efe7750d0fb36015c39d50a34675f9579/wordpress/writeleash/includes/free/class-price-cache-verifier.php#L8-L26).
- [Admin observation reference](https://github.com/MrDarkRoot/WriteLeash/blob/c48e307efe7750d0fb36015c39d50a34675f9579/wordpress/writeleash/includes/free/class-free-admin.php#L1469-L1489).
- [Woo public/Internal guidance](https://developer.woocommerce.com/docs/extensions/best-practices-extensions/extension-development-best-practices/), verified 2026-10-07.

210.title: Make merchant-facing UI translation-ready
210.body:
**Roadmap order: B2 (07 of 11)** · **Priority: P1** · **Phase: B — Woo Marketplace technical readiness**

Planning baseline: live `main` `c48e307efe7750d0fb36015c39d50a34675f9579`, fetched and checked 2026-10-07. This issue is scoped future work; v0.1 UX and WordPress.org submission stay closed. Founder retains final GO / NO-GO.

## Problem

The plugin declares `writeleash`, but Admin labels, errors, counts, discovery JavaScript and accessibility strings predominantly use raw English literals. Non-English stores cannot translate the complete merchant workflow.

## Why now

Translation readiness is part of the Marketplace candidate, without reopening completed v0.1 visual polishing or a general accessibility program. Inventory and localization architecture can start now; final string conversion should follow the relevant UI changes actually accepted for the candidate.

## Scope

- Inventory shipped merchant-visible PHP/JS text across setup/dependency errors, selection, Preview, Apply, progress, conflicts, History, export and Undo.
- Use gettext with the consistent `writeleash` text domain, plural/context functions and complete translatable sentences with placeholders/translators' comments where needed.
- Provide supported JS translations, including placeholders, dynamic counts, errors and accessible names; include a source catalog/build process as appropriate.
- Limit accessibility cleanup to translated accessible text and touched controls/status updates: labels, focus and announcements remain coherent.
- Keep stable machine reason codes, operation identifiers, plan hashes and canonical monetary values untranslated.

## Non-goals

No manual translation into many languages, WPML product synchronization, design-system/React rewrite, new accessibility matrix, marketing-copy reset or changes to pricing authority.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] A generated catalog captures runtime/Admin/JS/accessibility strings under `writeleash`; plural and contextual messages have correct extraction.
- [ ] A controlled non-English/pseudo-translation exercises selection, Preview, progress, errors, conflicts, History and Undo, including 0/1/many counts and long labels.
- [ ] Translations do not alter canonical prices, selection IDs, stored plan/journal material or CSV machine identifiers; existing plans still hydrate.
- [ ] Existing focused keyboard/browser checks cover the touched flows; translation and live updates do not steal focus or remove accessible names.
- [ ] Any catalog/asset additions use the public release allowlist and existing local asset model.

## Dependencies

**Roadmap sequencing:** second Marketplace engineering issue; ordering is not a prerequisite to begin.

**Functional dependency:** technically independent of product behavior and #209. Coordinate final string conversion with accepted Free UI changes so strings modified by #204–#208 are finalized after the affected UI settles. Deferred/unselected #207/#208 work does not have to close first. Reuse completed #170 coverage instead of recreating its gate.

## Parallel execution

String inventory, gettext architecture, JS localization and source-catalog/build tooling can proceed alongside #206, #209 and #213, without waiting for all Phase A issues. Isolate early tooling work from changing Admin views; coordinate small PRs/rebase for shared `class-free-admin.php` edits with #204/#205/#209. Finish conversion for UI changes selected into the candidate once those changes settle, avoiding duplicate churn.

## Evidence

- [PHP labels and counts](https://github.com/MrDarkRoot/WriteLeash/blob/c48e307efe7750d0fb36015c39d50a34675f9579/wordpress/writeleash/includes/free/class-free-admin.php#L1219-L1283).
- [JavaScript messages/accessibility text](https://github.com/MrDarkRoot/WriteLeash/blob/c48e307efe7750d0fb36015c39d50a34675f9579/wordpress/writeleash/includes/free/free-selection.js).
- [Woo internationalization guidance](https://developer.woocommerce.com/docs/extensions/best-practices-extensions/extension-development-best-practices/).
- #169/#170 are completed v0.1 work.

219.title: feat(selection): include subcategories and bounded expanded count (#206)
219.body:
Refs #206 — **draft for code review only. Do not merge; founder GO/NO-GO pending.**

Base: `c48e307efe7750d0fb36015c39d50a34675f9579` · Previous head: `eadd0c9505e31ee3de7197936bc617ebf5eb2d2d` · New head: `eaad5dd0b1703997667474edb55f928fd2e75d0d` (round-3 fix `5cf39c1027c41a8d02a7725deffc34d2e93f63c2`, docs receipts `eaad5dd`)

## Round-3 review finding addressed (P1: bounded CATEGORY discovery completeness)

Round 2 deduplicated raw rows in PHP and asked for SQL `DISTINCT`, but PHP keying cannot restore rows SQL `LIMIT` already removed, the `posts_distinct` guard was global while the constructor ran, and a full duplicate page was accepted as if complete.

- **Token-scoped DISTINCT:** `bounded_discovery_query()` now mints a private token query var and registers `add_filter( 'posts_distinct', $guard, 10, 2 )`; the 2-arg callback returns `'DISTINCT'` only when the second argument is a `\WP_Query` whose `writeleash_discovery_token` matches this query, otherwise returns the incoming clause unchanged. An unrelated or nested query built while the guard is registered keeps its own value; the guard is removed in `finally` on normal and exceptional exits.
- **Fail-closed completeness (CATEGORY only, before the sentinel and before any Woo read):**
  - window rewrite — `(int) $query->get('posts_per_page') !== $raw_limit + 1` → refuse;
  - full duplicate page — `count($query->posts) > count($raw_posts)` AND `count($query->posts) >= actual posts_per_page` → refuse (SQL may have truncated distinct rows before PHP dedupe could see them);
  - short duplicate page — proceed; every matching row was returned and keying is exact (each distinct product read once).
- **Refusal code unchanged:** existing `selection_limit_exceeded`; the Admin native count action surfaces the existing over-limit message (`selection_count = { over_limit: true }`, `class-free-admin.php` ~344-347) and Preview maps it to the existing `supported_job_limit_exceeded` wording. No new reason code or UI.
- **Conservatism disclosed:** in a DISTINCT-stripping environment (cache/plugin/filter) some otherwise-valid selections are now refused rather than resolved possibly-truncated — e.g. the 2,501-duplicate-row fixture that round 2 accepted now refuses (full duplicate window).
- **Unchanged:** `MAX_SELECTED` / `MAX_JOB_PRODUCTS` = 1,000; `posts_per_page = raw_limit + 1 = 2,001`; direct-members default; explicit opt-in; dedupe; Preview freeze; old-plan hydration; IDS/SKU ceilings.

## Files (round 3)

- `wordpress/writeleash/includes/free/class-product-selector.php` — token-scoped `posts_distinct` guard + fail-closed completeness in `resolve()`.
- `wordpress/tests/free/selection-count.php` — stub now models `WP_Query::get()`, 2-arg filter callbacks, construction throw, `posts_per_page` override, `posts_results`-style injection and a nested/unrelated query probe; 46 → 63 assertions.
- `wordpress/tests/free/variations.php` — stub `query_vars`/`get()` for the CATEGORY resolve path (73 assertions unchanged).
- `wordpress/tests/free/integration.php` — kept the IDS short duplicate acceptance; added a CATEGORY full-window duplicate refusal via `posts_results` injection.
- `docs/review/206/IMPLEMENTATION.md` — completeness argument, fail-closed behavior, receipts.

## Local validation (PASS unless noted)

- `selection-count.php` 63 assertions PASS (fail-closed matrix: full/short window × duplicates/no-duplicates × tamper × results-path injection, plus token scoping, exceptional cleanup, 2,000/2,001 distinct boundaries, 1,000/1,001 final targets, overlap, count/Preview divergence, old-plan hydration).
- Negative control: the same harness against round-2 bytes (`eadd0c95`) FAILs as expected at the 2,501 full-window duplicate refusal; the baseline `c48e307` opt-in negative control still FAILs as expected.
- `unit.php` 2,607 · `sale-price.php` 105 · `variations.php` 73 · admin-audit · no-replan · ownership `--audit` · package/inventory/public/readme/historical/claim-matrix audits · changed-file lint · `git diff --check`.
- GitNexus pre-edit impacts LOW (`bounded_discovery_query` exact; `resolve` 3-call-site receiver-typing gap confirmed by text search); `detect_changes --scope all` (4 files / 16 symbols / 6 flows, high) and `--scope staged`, no partial/truncated.
- Ownership for the changed paths still `{"PR_FAST": true, "CODE_INTEGRATION": ["admin", "jobs", "journal", "plan", "undo"], ...}`.
- **`pr-fast.sh` FAILS only at the unchanged #170 UI source/capture evidence gate** — fresh approved browser capture required; no evidence was rehashed and no assertion/audit was weakened.

## NOT_TESTED (blocked) / remaining blockers

- Real Woo/Admin HTTP fixtures (`integration.php`, `selection-http.php`, `selection-integration.php`, `subcategory-integration.php`) and no-JS/browser accessibility — Docker daemon unavailable (`/var/run/docker.sock` absent).
- PR_FAST #170 reviewed-capture fingerprint; runtime/UI acceptance. Issue #206 is not claimed closed or release-ready.
- Support claims: unchanged (manifest, screenshots and proofs untouched).

## Deviations

- Fail-closed completeness can refuse some genuinely valid selections in a DISTINCT-stripping environment; chosen over resolving a possibly truncated population and disclosed with the Admin/Preview message mapping.
- Added `query_vars`/`get()` to the `variations.php` stub so the CATEGORY resolve path mirrors `WP_Query::get()`; assertion count unchanged.
- Two commits (fix + docs receipts) rather than one, matching the branch's existing pattern.

Receipts: `/tmp/writeleash-approved-20261008/evidence/pr-fix3/219/fix3-*.log`.


## Round 4 — real runtime acceptance (lead-run equivalent environment)
WordPress 7.1.2 + WooCommerce 11.1.2, PHP 8.2.32, pinned MySQL 8.0.44 / MariaDB 10.11.15 (tarball builds), default + Redis 7.4.2 object cache:
- `#107` free planning suite (includes selection resolution/completeness): **PASS**, both engines.
- `#111` Admin E2E incl. `selection-integration`/`selection-http`/subcategory fixtures: **PASS 838 assertions**, MySQL default and Redis.
- `#170` integrated-candidate real-browser journeys (Chromium 148.0.7778.178 + Playwright Firefox 151.0, 253 assertions each): **PASS** — see runtime-acceptance-evidence.
Remaining: PR_FAST #170 on this isolated branch still fails because reviewed capture is integrated-candidate scoped; Docker unavailable (user-space equivalent used; details in RUNTIME-ACCEPTANCE-REPORT.md).


## Round 5 — final verification
Evidence-to-source mapping spot-verified (staged plugin trees match this head exactly); integrated candidate rebuilt from exact PR heads is byte-identical to the validated candidate (`330859f`); #170 remains candidate-scoped. **Recommendation: GO FOR REVIEW** (per-step #170 refresh or authorized integration PR; see `FINAL-MERGE-READINESS.md` §E).

220.title: fix(cache): remove Woo Internal cache dependencies from runtime paths (#209)
220.body:
Refs #209 — **draft for code review only. Do not merge; founder GO/NO-GO pending.**

Base: `c48e307efe7750d0fb36015c39d50a34675f9579` · Round-2 head: `7496874eb0b48989814234afb703d17a5563ace0` · Round-3 head: `029a08040da0fab06bfea2a8d174aeba3d72f2d4` (docs/tests only)

## P0 review finding addressed — recovery semantics

The reviewed implementation classified every non-core resolved class as `unreadable_product_data`, turning the previously **terminal** unsupported outcome into a **retryable (PENDING)** one. This fix restores the established terminal refusal and keeps transient read failures typed and conservatively retryable.

Behavioral changes:
- `Product_Price_Snapshot::fresh_product()`
  - A resolved string that is a `WC_Product` subclass outside the three exact core classes (`WC_Product_Simple`, `WC_Product_Variation`, `WC_Product_Variable`) → `Price_Validation_Error('unsupported_product_type')` (stable unsupported, terminal), **never instantiated**.
  - A resolved string that is not a `WC_Product` at all (e.g. `stdClass`) is a broken mapping, not a product type → `unreadable_product_data` (satisfies the required `stdClass → unreadable_product_data` case).
  - `unreadable_product_data` also covers missing WP/Woo functions/classes, suspended invalidation, non-string classname, constructor failure (the literal core constructors are now wrapped in try/catch), and constructor result mismatch.
  - No `new $var`; only the three literal core constructors (unchanged public-runtime audit).
- Selector: stable `unsupported_product_type` → new `$unsupported_type` collection (top-level and `expand_variable_parents` children); everything else → `$unreadable`. Unsupported IDs are included in the final `MAX_SELECTED` count and final frozen ID set, and become `Product_Price_Snapshot::unsupported_type()` snapshots (`exists=true`, `unreadable=false`, no core identity/prices) so `Product_Price_Eligibility` yields the established `unsupported_product_type` reason. Unsupported children never drop silently from the frozen population.
- Execution boundaries (baseline outcomes verified against `c48e307`):
  - Apply pre-check: `unsupported_product_type` → `Price_Apply_Error('UNSUPPORTED_PRODUCT_STATE')` → durable `FAILED` (terminal) with zero write; any other `Price_Validation_Error` is rethrown → `FAILED` → `PENDING` (retryable).
  - Undo entry pre-check: same conversion.
  - Undo recovery/verification read: `unsupported_product_type` → `CACHE_VERIFICATION_FAILED`, matching the pre-change exact-class comparison (NEEDS_REVIEW).
  - `Price_Cache_Verifier::sync_variable_parent()`: additional restoration — a stable unsupported parent maps to `CONFLICT`, the pre-change exact-class outcome, so a concurrent parent type change can no longer demote CONFLICT to retryable. Transient read failures still rethrow.
  - `observe()` / `observe_variable_parent()` continue to convert non-`Price_Apply_Error` to `CACHE_VERIFICATION_FAILED` at their callers; `product_observation` catch-all → `Unavailable`; `variation_facts()` parent read catch → `null` — unchanged.
- No change to state-mapping arrays, conflict handling, verification strength, write paths, or resume/history semantics. CONFLICT and NEEDS_REVIEW are never reset; APPLIED is never inferred from target equality.

## Files changed
- `wordpress/writeleash/includes/free/class-product-snapshot.php` — classification + `unsupported_type()`.
- `wordpress/writeleash/includes/free/class-product-selector.php` — unsupported collection, IDs and count.
- `wordpress/writeleash/includes/free/class-woo-price-mutator.php` — Apply mapping.
- `wordpress/writeleash/includes/free/class-woo-undo-mutator.php` — entry + recovery mapping.
- `wordpress/writeleash/includes/free/class-price-cache-verifier.php` — parent-sync CONFLICT restoration.
- `wordpress/tests/free/cache-public.php` — extension → `unsupported_product_type`; extension never constructed; `stdClass`/non-product and core constructor-result mismatch → `unreadable_product_data`; suspended/absent unchanged.
- `wordpress/tests/free/variations.php` — extension parent eligibility restored to `unsupported_product_type`; unsupported snapshot `exists=true/unreadable=false`; SKU admission filter now by eligibility with the byte-match assertion unchanged.
- `wordpress/tests/durable/cache-public-integration.php` — extension class mapping at Apply → terminal `UNSUPPORTED_PRODUCT_STATE`/durable FAILED with no write; non-product classname → retryable FAILED/durable PENDING; public-API-only fixture style.

## Test evidence
- Local PASS: `cache-public` (73), `unit` (2,607), `sale-price` (105), `variations` (75), `admin-audit`, `no-replan-audit`, `package-preflight`, `inventory-audit`, `public-audit-cases`, `readme-validate`, `historical-shim-cases`, `claim-matrix`, `source-audit`, `ownership --audit`, `dependency-audit`, `test-artifact`, PHP/JS/shell lint, `git diff --check` clean.
- GitNexus: pre-edit upstream impacts were run for every edited production symbol (`fresh_product` CRITICAL/11 direct callers, `resolve` LOW, `expand_variable_parents` LOW, `apply` HIGH lower-bound — 1 production caller `attempt_item` plus tests confirmed by text search, `restore` HIGH, `observe_undo` HIGH, `sync_variable_parent` CRITICAL/2) before editing; `detect-changes --scope all` and `--scope staged` complete (8 files / 22 symbols / 35 flows, risk critical, no partial/truncated), post-commit clean.
- Durable additions are wired into the existing Docker harness; execution **NOT_TESTED** (Docker daemon unavailable). Pure mutator-mapping coverage is durable/Docker-only — no pure harness can load the mutator without Woo/wpdb.

## Remaining blockers
- `pr-fast.sh` fails only at the unchanged **#170 UI evidence gate** (`asset-audit.php`): the UI source differs from the reviewed capture because the prior implementation commit touched `class-free-admin.php`. No evidence/assertion/fingerprint was edited. `asset-audit-cases.php` fails identically at the pre-existing head (same gate).
- Docker runtime durable Woo/MySQL/MariaDB/Redis/browser execution **NOT_TESTED**.

## Support-claim impact
None. `WOOCOMMERCE_MIN 10.0.0` / `WOOCOMMERCE_MAX_EXCLUSIVE 12.0.0` unchanged; no version-conditional branch added.

## Deviations requiring founder approval
None — the prior deviation (unsupported → unreadable / terminal → retryable) is resolved. Implementation notes, not approval-requiring: (1) non-`WC_Product` resolved strings stay `unreadable_product_data` while `WC_Product` subclasses are terminal, which is how `stdClass → unreadable` and `extension → unsupported` are both satisfied; (2) `sync_variable_parent()` is an additional restoration site beyond the listed ones, required to keep the pre-change CONFLICT outcome.

## Integration / Problem B
No shipped `Internal` reference including escaped strings, no `new $`, no `wc_get_container`, no global cache flush; targeted invalidation only. Test-only residual: `wordpress/tests/admin/integration.php:729` still primes Woo's private cache to stage stale state (not shipped; deliberately untouched).



## Round-3 recovery-semantics evidence (`029a080`)

Round-3 is verification-only: **no production code changed**. New commit `029a08040da0fab06bfea2a8d174aeba3d72f2d4` adds the recovery-semantics matrix and durable fixtures; branch is a fast-forward over `7496874e…`.

### End-to-end traces and the required proofs
- Full matrix (reason → durable journal/item state → retryable? → what guards re-execution) plus all seven required proofs with branch-HEAD `file:line` citations: `docs/review/209/IMPLEMENTATION.md`, section “Round-3 recovery-semantics evidence”.
- Proof 1 (terminal unsupported): round-2 durable case confirmed at `tests/durable/cache-public-integration.php:126-137` (`WC_Product_External` mapped for the Apply read → `UNSUPPORTED_PRODUCT_STATE`/durable `FAILED`/zero write); planning-level terminal refusal cited at `class-product-selector.php:83-87,127-129`.
- Proof 2 (transient refusal ≠ safe-to-retry write): every retry is a fresh `apply()` whose first actions are the journal lock + `PENDING` gate, storage row locks, targeted invalidation, frozen `precondition` MATCH, expected-price and sale/regular coherence, and re-authorization — the Woo save is last and shares the transaction (`class-woo-price-mutator.php:76-150`). New durable regressions: `cache-public-integration.php:149-186` (transient refusal → zero saves + durable `PENDING`; retry → one save; a concurrent edit between attempts → `CONFLICT`, zero overwrite) and `tests/jobs/integration.php:516-558` (job-level `PENDING`/`FAILED`/`attempt_count=1`/`RETRY_BACKOFF`; retry re-runs the precondition and preserves the newer edit).
- Proof 3 (no uncertain write repeated): `$committed+FAILED ⇒ AMBIGUOUS_COMMIT` (`:174`); failed rollback ⇒ `TRANSACTION_LOST` (`:175-177`); both ⇒ `NEEDS_REVIEW` (`:179-194`), which is terminal at item level (`class-job-state.php:90`) and never re-claimed (`claim_next_item` PENDING-only).
- Proof 4 (durable state gates retry): `APPLIED` ⇒ `ALREADY_APPLIED`, no second save (`class-woo-price-mutator.php:80-85`); job-row transactional fence + journal row lock + lease-generation CAS fence duplicate Resume. New job fixture: killed worker between checkpoints (`AFTER_WOO_SAVE_BEFORE_JOURNAL`, `AFTER_JOURNAL_BEFORE_COMMIT`) leaves durable `PENDING`/original price; recovery reconciles and applies once (`tests/jobs/integration.php:485-514`).
- Proof 5 (no blind overwrite): precondition + stored truth + coherence before save; newer edits win as `CONFLICT` terminal with zero write.
- Proof 6 (Undo conflict-aware): `UNDO_CONFLICT` terminal, `UNDO_NEEDS_REVIEW` for uncertainty, later edits/sale configuration preserved; interrupted Undo already covered at `tests/undo/integration.php:385-441`.
- Proof 7 (no uncertain→APPLIED/UNDONE): success states are written only by the two in-transaction transitions (`class-woo-price-mutator.php:164`, `class-woo-undo-mutator.php:228`); target-equality without journal evidence is `CONFLICT` (`durable/integration.php:232-235`).

### Test deltas and executed checks
- `tests/durable/cache-public-integration.php` +38 assertions; `tests/jobs/integration.php` + interrupted-before-COMMIT recovery loop and transient-retry blocks; `tests/jobs/worker.php` + test-only public `woocommerce_product_class` fault knob. `php -l` clean; `git diff --check` clean.
- Battery PASS on the round-3 tree: `cache-public` 73, `unit` 2607, `sale-price` 105, `variations` 75, admin-audit, no-replan-audit, ownership, dependency-audit, package-preflight, inventory-audit, public-audit, readme, historical-shim, claim-matrix, source-audit.
- GitNexus (clone-local index, runner identity verified, status fresh at `029a080`): `detect-changes --scope all` and `--scope staged` complete (4 files / 10 symbols / 0 processes / risk low), post-commit clean.

### Remaining divergence + founder approval
The transient `unreadable_product_data` → `FAILED` → durable `PENDING` retry **remains a divergence** from the pre-#209 terminal baseline. Round-3 proves it is not unsafe re-execution (rollback-before-retry, full precondition re-run, journal-gated `PENDING`, 3-attempt budget) but it is **not approved**: explicit founder sign-off is still required. No production change was made to remove it.

### Blockers / NOT_TESTED
- `bash .github/ci/pr-fast.sh` fails only at the unchanged **#170 UI source/capture fingerprint** (21 PASS, then `asset-audit.php:6`), exactly as before.
- Docker daemon unavailable (`docker info` exit 1, no `/var/run/docker.sock`): all new durable fixtures and the Docker battery (`durable/`, `jobs/`, `undo/`) are **NOT_TESTED**, not PASS. Receipts: `evidence/pr-fix3/220/`.

## Round 4 — real runtime acceptance (lead-run equivalent environment)
WordPress 7.1.2 + WooCommerce 11.1.2, pinned MySQL 8.0.44 / MariaDB 10.11.15, default + Redis 7.4.2:
- `#108` durable cache/journal gate (kill-before/after COMMIT, rollback, retry, current-price): **PASS**, both engines × both caches (396 assertions in final matrix).
- `#109` jobs gate incl. interrupted workers, duplicate Resume fencing, deadlock stress, unicode: **PASS**, both engines × both caches (160 PASS lines; one load-induced isolated failure reproduced as PASS on clean re-run — both logs preserved).
- `#110` conflict-aware Undo gate incl. kill-after-COMMIT: **PASS**, both engines × both caches.
- Transient `unreadable_product_data` retry divergence **remains** and still requires explicit founder approval; runtime evidence confirms retries re-run full journal/precondition fences and never blind-overwrite.


## Round 5 — final verification (HOLD)
The Round-4 #109 deadlock-stress failure was **reproduced in a fully isolated run** (`final-merge-evidence/race/jobs-B4-isolated-FAIL.log`) while other isolated and instrumented runs passed: `actual [COMPLETED_WITH_ISSUES, NEEDS_REVIEW]` vs expected `[COMPLETED, COMPLETED_WITH_ISSUES]`. Durable state shows the winner committed `APPLIED/WOO_CRUD_VERIFIED` then its post-commit `observe()` threw `CACHE_VERIFICATION_FAILED` (conservative, no overwrite; one save). No InnoDB deadlock; not load-attributable; instrumented attempts did not reproduce. Classification: **FLAKY / UNRESOLVED**. **Recommendation: HOLD** until hosted CI reproduction/attribution or founder acceptance. The transient-retry semantics decision also remains open.


## Round 6 — reproduced #109 defect fixed (root cause + regression)
Instrumented real-runtime evidence pinned the intermittent `different jobs same product` failure: after a verified commit (`APPLIED / WOO_CRUD_VERIFIED`, raw DB correct), the public Woo read could still serve the **pre-write value from the in-process `post_meta` blob cache**, so post-commit observation degraded to `NEEDS_REVIEW / CACHE_VERIFICATION_FAILED` (conservative: one save, no overwrite).
Fix `c2e3f616`: `observe()` keeps the independent storage-vs-journal comparison as authority and, on a public-read mismatch, evicts the targeted product caches (`wp_cache_delete` + `wp_cache_delete_multiple` + `product_<id>` group) and reconstructs the product **exactly once**; a persistent mismatch still fails closed.
Regression: `tests/durable/cache-public-integration.php` R4 deterministically emulates the stale blob — unfixed bytes fail at `class-price-cache-verifier.php:268`, fixed bytes pass (64 assertions, zero extra saves). Stability: the exact runner config that failed 5/5 pre-fix passed 2/2 full `#109` gates (two engines × default/Redis) post-fix.
Evidence: `docs/review/parallel-20261008-handoff/round6-evidence/` (traces, value-level diagnostics, before/after regression, runner PASS logs).


Round-6 integrated validation: the rebuilt disposable candidate (`3b4ab5e`, four PR heads) passes the full `#109` jobs gate and `#108` durable gate on MySQL + MariaDB × default + Redis, plus the local battery and PR_FAST (see `ROUND-6-CORRECTNESS-REPORT.md`).

221.title: feat(admin): refresh running job progress without reloading (#204)
221.body:
Refs #204 — **draft for code review only. Do not merge; founder GO/NO-GO pending.** Base: `c48e307efe7750d0fb36015c39d50a34675f9579` · Previous head: `1e218cb8cab63d796dd4440aa17e6eeff59b5abd` · Head: `19e2c6892c5887bb53a4a470979a44d3822e3480` (`test(admin): exhaustively verify progress row/focus reconciliation (#204)`, plus a docs wording follow-up) ## Scope - Authenticated read-only `wp_ajax_writeleash_free_progress` (+ explicit nopriv refusal): user `0` gets a generic 403 before any repository read; job-bound nonce, capability + creator/approver/administrator authorization, bounded offset/filter. - Endpoint reads **only persisted** plan/job/item/Undo state — no schema install, no worker/Resume invocation, no product read, no cache eviction; missing saved evidence disables actions and polling. - Isolated `free-progress.js`: updates counters/outcomes/action availability, preserves page-load current-price cells, labels filtered rows as needing reload, handles stalled/partial/error/session states, records last successful refresh, generation fence for out-of-order responses, single in-flight request, 15 s timeout, hidden-page pause, 10/20/40 s backoff, stops after four failures or terminal jobs; focus-preserving with concise polite announcements; native refresh/no-JS retained. - Minimal asset additions: explicit manifest, public-asset allowlist entry, ownership registration. ## Review fix pass (HEAD `1e218cb`) - **A — row/page sync (fixed):** `updateRows()` now reconciles rendered row order to the durable server page order via `insertBefore`; previously new rows were appended and existing rows never moved, so the visible list could disagree with the current filter/page. A focused row is never moved (moving a focused node drops focus): it keeps its place and the other rows are ordered around it; with no focus the server order is exact. Regression verified: the pre-fix client fails the new reorder test. - **A — focused stale indicator (wording fixed):** focused outcome cells, focused removed review links and focused initial support details now explicitly state they still show the previous saved details/view until focus leaves. Mechanism unchanged (connection line as indicator; focused nodes retained until blur). - **A — verified unchanged:** Apply/Undo counters, attention classes, generation fence, 401/403 stop + backoff, four-failure stop, hidden pause/resume, terminal poll stop, announcement de-duplication, no-JS mount, no framework. - **B — verified unchanged:** actor/capability + job-bound nonce before reads; identical two-key refusal for anonymous/cross-actor/guessed IDs; endpoint read-only (no mutation/worker); `process_resume`/`process_undo` independently re-check capability, POST, dependency, job, action nonce, actor authorization, terminal/resumable state and plan binding; missing durable evidence fails closed. - **Pager selector checked against `render_pager`:** the single `

` has the Previous control first and the Next control last, so `querySelector('p').lastElementChild` is correct for both the link and disabled-button shapes; no selector change needed (terminal shape now pinned by test). ## Fix-pass tests - `progress-client.cjs`: server-order reconciliation (with/without focus), focused stale wording, focused removed row/link, filter/page change with no stale rows, empty-state removal, pager `next_url` create/update/hide/show + terminal disabled-button shape, 401 and 403 stop, first-failure backoff message, timeout abort + retry, hidden pause/resume, four-failure stop, announcement de-dup, PHP constant/action/field parity and every JS `data-*` selector checked against the PHP renderer, no-framework assertion. - `progress-unit.php`: job-bound nonce mismatch, guessed public ID with a valid nonce (visibility lookup only), missing/non-string nonce, method case, offset at/over the real `MAX_EVIDENCE_ROWS` (double now mirrors `class-undo-repository.php`), extra repository-failure paths, and `__callStatic` mutation sentinels + `Job_Worker`/`Undo_Worker` sentinels asserted empty (negative controls confirmed). - `progress-integration.php`: guessed-public-ID refusal now audited through the poll-only SQL/product-read wrapper (Docker-bound, NOT_TESTED). ## Behavior changes 1. Row-order reconciliation in `free-progress.js` (the only synchronization behavior change). 2. Explicit stale wording for focused nodes. Justification in `docs/review/204/IMPLEMENTATION.md` §“2026-10-08 review fix pass”. Files in the fix commit: `wordpress/writeleash/includes/free/free-progress.js`, `wordpress/tests/admin/progress-client.cjs`, `wordpress/tests/admin/progress-unit.php`, `wordpress/tests/admin/progress-integration.php`, `docs/review/204/IMPLEMENTATION.md`. Support-claim impact: none (no listing/supported ceilings changed). Deviations: none. ## Local validation (PASS unless noted) - `node wordpress/tests/admin/progress-client.cjs` PASS · `php wordpress/tests/admin/progress-unit.php` PASS · admin-audit · package-preflight (43-file closure) · inventory · public-audit-cases · test-artifact (10) · ownership + dependency · readme · historical-shim · guard-control (real manifest accepted; unknown/unreferenced assets and `new $class` rejected) · lint + `git diff --check` PASS. - GitNexus `detect_changes` complete for the fix commit (5 files / 73 symbols / 14 flows, risk high — dominated by test-double and doc symbol churn; the edited production symbol `updateRows` is LOW and `progress_snapshot` LOW), no partial/truncated. - **`pr-fast.sh` FAILS only at the unchanged #170 UI evidence gate** (`asset-audit.php:100`); log byte-identical to the prior run apart from timing. ## NOT_TESTED (blocked) - Real Woo poll audit and real AJAX session journey (`progress-integration.php` extended, not executed), real browser keyboard/live-update/accessibility (axe), expired-session behavior — Docker/browser unavailable in this runtime. Real-browser row reorder/refocus behavior after DOM moves remains the main uncertainty the deterministic DOM tests cannot settle. ## Round-3 verification (HEAD `19e2c68`) Test/document-only commit; **no production code changed and no production defect demonstrated**. Round 3 started at `1e218cb8…`; `origin/main` unchanged at `c48e307e…`. - **Exhaustive `updateRows()` order/focus enumeration (0 violations):** shipped `free-progress.js` executed under the deterministic DOM harness with every server page order for n=1..4 × every focus position (none; each seeded row, including rows present in the server list at every position and rows being removed; a row created during reconciliation cannot hold focus, so the reachable equivalent is focus on a retained row while another row is added). Result: **9,996 cases, 69,481 assertion checks, 1,198 focused-removed deferrals, 0 violations** for: no duplicates; final set = server set; non-focused rows keep server relative order; focused rows never moved/removed; exact server order without focus; a focused removed row defers the whole previous view with its explicit message (documented policy). - **Sensitivity:** the updated suite exits 1 against the pre-fix client `6a6a9ac`; an expanded task-owned enumeration (35,491 cases) reports 30,949 violations against the pre-fix client vs 0 against the shipped client. - **Read-only endpoint audit:** `handle_progress()`/`progress_snapshot()` perform only the actor/capability/POST gate, job-bound nonce, bounded offset/filter, `Job_Schema::ready` (option + `information_schema` SELECTs), `read_by_public_id`, `observe`, `hydrate_plan`, `history_job`, `observe`, `history_items` (all SELECT/join reads) and response formatting; no install, worker, Resume, product read, cache eviction or repository mutation; failures fail closed `UNAVAILABLE`. - **Sentinel strengthening:** doubles now assert exact reads-only method sets; `Job_Worker::callback`, `Undo_Worker::queue_undo`/`callback` sentinels added; self-controls prove the mutation sentinel intercepts all 16 job + 18 undo production writer names and the worker sentinels record all six entrypoints, with state restored before the end-of-suite assertions. - **Resume/Undo authority citations:** `process_resume` re-checks `can_mutate` (:604), exact POST (:607), dependency (:610), job regex/read (:612), action+job-bound nonce (:616-619), actor (:621), terminal (:624), `can_manual_run` (:627), plan binding (:631), per-product rights (:637) before `Job_Worker::run` (:643); `process_undo` mirrors this (:664-681), delegates durable checks to `Undo_Repository::initiate` under `FOR UPDATE` (:123-209) and re-checks terminal state (:695) before `Undo_Worker::run` (:699). New tests cover POST/capability/job-regex/job-bound nonce/action-mixed nonce/cross-actor/terminal-Resume-with-valid-nonce/`resume_available=true` and prove the process bodies never read `resume_available`/`undo_available`/`undo_button`/resume/undo nonces. - **Battery (PASS):** progress-client (9,996-case enumeration) · progress-unit (handler authority + sentinels) · admin-audit · package-preflight · inventory · public-audit-cases · test-artifact · ownership · dependency · readme · historical-shim · lint + `git diff --check`. `pr-fast.sh` **FAILS only at the unchanged #170 UI evidence gate** (`asset-audit.php:100`), output byte-identical to the prior receipt after timing normalization. GitNexus `detect_changes` all+staged complete (3 files / 14 symbols / 17 flows) and branch `compare` vs main complete (12 files / 165 symbols / 20 flows), risk critical from test-double/doc symbol churn, no partial/truncated. - **NOT_TESTED (unchanged):** no WP/Woo runtime or browser environment — `/var/run/docker.sock` absent (`docker info` fails), uid 1000 with `newuidmap`/`newgidmap` absent and `nf_tables` not loaded, `browser-tools` declares Playwright/axe but no `node_modules` installed. Real-browser live Apply/Undo, keyboard, axe, expired-session journeys and Docker-bound `progress-integration.php` remain NOT_TESTED; no browser/Woo claim is made. Full accounting: `docs/review/204/IMPLEMENTATION.md` (this branch). Lead report: `docs/review/parallel-20261008-handoff/FINAL-REPORT.md` (local workspace, not pushed). ## Round-4 runtime defect fix (HEAD `fd0dc73`) Previous HEAD: `19e2c6892c5887bb53a4a470979a44d3822e3480`; new HEAD: `fd0dc73e8a1598da1c894a6be24be28f860c286d`; `origin/main` unchanged at `c48e307e…`. Real-browser acceptance against the integrated candidate (WordPress 7.1.2, WooCommerce 11.1.2, MySQL 8.0.44, host Chrome via Playwright 1.61) reproduced a genuine live-progress defect. - **Defect:** after the first successful poll, `free-progress.js` replaced the server-rendered Apply/Undo conflict cell text with the short `reason_message()` variants (`Not changed · The product changed after review; …` / `Not restored · The product changed after WriteLeash applied its price; …`), so the merchant-visible guidance silently changed wording and the real-browser journey failed at `readable Undo preservation` (`regression-browser.cjs:275`; the Apply check at ~:259 passed only by pre-poll timing). Host dump: `/tmp/wlruntime/evidence/round4-defect/live-undo-page-dump.txt`; DB outcomes were correct (`UNDO_CONFLICT` recorded, prices preserved). - **Root cause:** `progress_snapshot()` composed rows from short reason strings while `render_item_outcome()` embedded the long guidance locally — two spellings of one message. - **Fix (production, `class-free-admin.php` only):** new `outcome_conflict_copy( ?string $state )` holding the two long sentences (U+2019 preserved); `render_item_outcome()` prints from the helper (no behavior change); `progress_snapshot()` uses `' · ' . ` for `CONFLICT`/`UNDO_CONFLICT` and keeps the existing `reason_message()` fallback otherwise, including the `null === undo_state` branch. No other text, labels, attention flags or read-only behavior changed. - **Regression + discriminator:** `progress-unit.php` now parameterizes the conflict fixture and asserts exact long copy for CONFLICT (null reason and `ITEM_CONFLICT`) and `UNDO_CONFLICT`, short variants absent, and each long sentence stored once (148 checks). `progress-client.cjs` extracts both sentences from the PHP source and asserts verbatim cell writes and focused-outcome deferral (9,996 cases / 69,481 checks, 0 violations). Both PASS; the updated unit suite fails against pre-fix bytes `19e2c68` at the first new check (exit 255) — see `evidence/pr-fix4/221/`. - **Impact receipts:** pre-edit upstream `render_item_outcome` HIGH (5 impacted, render / render_job_view / render_preview_view flows); `progress_snapshot` LOW (caller `handle_progress`). `detect_changes --scope all` + `--scope staged`: 19 symbols / 4 files, complete, no partial/truncated (critical risk dominated by test-double/doc name-collision over-attribution). - **Battery (PASS):** progress-client · progress-unit · admin-audit · package-preflight · inventory · public-audit-cases · readme · historical-shim · ownership (admin) · dependency · lint + `git diff --check`. `pr-fast.sh` FAILS only at the preserved #170 UI evidence gate; output byte-identical to the prior receipt after timing normalization. - **Remaining blockers (unchanged):** real-browser re-verification of the polled Apply/Undo conflict rows is performed by the lead on the integrated candidate after this push; Docker/WP/Woo browser runtime remains unavailable here, so the Docker-bound `progress-integration.php` and the full `regression-browser.cjs` journey are NOT_TESTED in this clone. ## Round 4 — runtime acceptance and browser-reproduced defect fix Real-browser journey on the integrated candidate found the polled rows rewrote conflict guidance (short `reason_message` variants) after load; fixed in `fd0dc73` by sharing one conflict-copy source between the server render and `progress_snapshot()` (regression added; pre-fix bytes fail the new assertion). - `#170` journeys (Chromium 148 + Firefox 151, 253 assertions each) + live-polling test: **PASS** — counters advanced 0→10 changed / 22→12 remaining with `noReload` intact and automatic updates active. - `progress-integration.php` (persisted Apply/Undo, actor/nonce bounds, read-only SQL/product-read audit, conflict/terminal, no-JS/missing evidence): **PASS** on MySQL default and Redis. - `#111` Admin E2E: **PASS 838 assertions** on default and Redis. ## Round 5 — final verification Integrated rebuild is byte-identical to the validated candidate (`330859f`); #170 both engines PASS with genuine refreshed captures on the candidate; live-polling evidence re-verified. **Recommendation: GO FOR REVIEW** (per-step #170 refresh or authorized integration PR).

Refs #210 — **PARTIAL: preparation only. Draft; do not merge; founder GO/NO-GO pending.**

Base: `c48e307efe7750d0fb36015c39d50a34675f9579` · Previous HEAD: `b09fd5f226ea45e711352b8654e3ab3f09d0d1f3` · New HEAD: `4c7f6b2fd919b0c2a84922f15dd1b9bfdaca26fd`

- **Gates**: `python3 .github/ci/ownership.py --audit` **PASS**; `bash .github/ci/pr-fast.sh` **PASS** (`#133 PR_FAST PASS`). CI re-runs on `079f5da`.

## Scope (inventory/tooling/docs/tests only — no production UI edits)

## Local validation (this branch)
